item.title: Sixth COLA is $250
item.description: The sixth regular cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for career letter carriers under the 2023-2026 National Agreement was $250 annually following the release of the January consumer price index (CPI).

item.title: NALC statement on the murder of Branch 2225 member Dequavious Graves
item.description: NALC is heartbroken by the murder of Dequavious Graves, our brother from Branch 2225 in Decatur, GA.

item.title: NALC website and member app survey
item.description: NALC is gathering feedback about how members and others use nalc.org and the NALC Member App as we look to redesign and improve these communication tools. The survey takes about 10 minutes and is open through March 10, 2026.

item.title: House postal caucus briefed on pressing issues
item.description: Today, NALC President Brian Renfroe and other postal union and association leaders briefed the House postal caucus on the most pressing issues facing letter carriers and all postal employees.
